items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: It was all-star. Metheny, Joshua [Redman]. ... So it’s me, Garzone, I think Josh, and Michael. We did Impressions. We did India.

ctx.x: Who probably would have dropped him after two years.

That’s the other thing to be said. Right. We don’t know. Exactly. But we see Metheny. We see Scofield had a life at the top. So there was room. I don’t know. But yeah, of course. At least he’s made 30 records with the same guy. That’s guy’s hard. He’s hard even to his boys. Eicher, he’s tough. Oh boy. From the sessions, he’s a rough one. I couldn’t get along with him. We were like oil and water. It was not going to work. After Drum Ode, it was too much for me.
A German and a New York Jew? That’s a hard . . .
